doc.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25

title: Harmonica and drum tricks
summary: Bailey describes playing harmonica with a derby, imitating trains and playing a whole tune solo on trap drums.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Harmonica guitar followed by name Eddie Bole. He got mad and he moved and went to Iowa. You know where the Lightinghamer's Bakery shop is on Melpameen? And the Simon Bolegoire? Lightinghamer's Bakery?
I can't place… Oh yeah, I know that's at Melpameen. Is that the one?
There's a big tour of the house, two-star house right in the back of that between Simon Bolegoire and Liberty.

We played a wedding up there, a house-packing game. Harmonica and Gipcho. And I had a derby put over the harmonica. And that guy played with the knife. And he was talking about some music. And we made some money that night.
Put a derby over the harmonica?

Eat a can, get a can, anything. You know, this duck, be flowing this. You ever seen a trumpet player put the duck on? Yeah, sure. And I make that harmonica talk. I can play with my nose. Play with my north. Learned all that when I was a kid.

And I can imitate the train on harmonica. I can imitate the train on my snap drum. And I can take the trap, you know, the whole set, and play the whole part of high society. I can't do it. I can't do it.
On the trap drums. I'll just let you know that I'm playing it. And I'll start off, if you understand, play the whole thing. Just by myself.
Can you play the drums and the harmonica at the same time?
Sure. If I had the rack, I'd have to have the rack. Yeah, do you have a rack? No, I have no rack. I might have to get you one.
I'll make you one out of a clothes hanger or something.
Yeah. I believe you can buy those things. Yeah, you can buy them.
I had one one time. Yeah.
Yeah, sure. I could play a harmonica, play a harmonica, play a harmonica. I like music, you know. Yeah. To do good at something, you got to like it. I guess that's why I do that thing.
